captionStarter: 49ers 36-30 over Cardinals. The trick play went 82 yards on the third snap.
concept: Quick hit: The 82-yard hook-and-ladder play broken down frame by frame
description: The San Francisco 49ers beat the Arizona Cardinals 36-30 behind four Brock Purdy touchdown passes, including an 82-yard hook-and-ladder trick play to open the game.
headline: 49ers pull off 82-yard hook-and-ladder, hold off Cardinals 36-30
